solution:
names = ["下围棋", "识别人脸", "翻译句子", "写代码"]
values = [5, 4, 3, 2]
threshold = 3

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
